description: Check a US job post against state and city pay-range posting laws (table checked 2026-10-05) for the job's state, optional city or county, total employer size and remote status. Returns the laws that may apply, what the post shows (pay range, benefits, other compensation, deadline), what may be missing, and official sources. Plain-language checks, not legal advice.
name: check_pay_transparency
title: Check a job post against pay transparency laws
